events.details: Monteverdi Choir and Orchestras: Handel’s Theodora About Monteverdi Choir and Orchestras: Handel’s Theodora Handel’s great oratorio is one of the most celebrated choral works of the 18th century. A radical vision of faith and freedom. Performed by the Monteverdi Choir and English Baroque Soloists, under the direction of Christophe Rousset, this concert staging brings new light to Handel’s masterpiece. events.details: Welsh National Opera – La boheme About Welsh National Opera – La boheme In the Latin Quarter of Paris, four young artists live for the moment, sharing what little they have, chasing big dreams and laughing through the cold. When Rodolfo meets Mimì, a quiet seamstress with a fading light, their connection is instant and unforgettable. But in a world shaped by poverty and passion, love burns brightly but all too briefly. events.details: Takács Quartet About Takács Quartet Music from across the centuries, in the hands of true chamber music masters. For over fifty years, Takács Quartet has stood at the forefront of chamber music, receiving global acclaim for their innovative performances at the world’s most revered concert halls and collaborations with luminaries such as Philip Seymour Hoffman, Robert Pinsky and more.
